name: evo_inspect
description: Progressive disclosure loader. Fetch L1 (contract / schema / symbol freshness) or L2 (full SOP / script source / Episodic Memory with AST Anti-Drift report & CodeGraph Topology Penetration anchors) for a specific Rule, Skill, Micro-Tool, or Memory.

id.description: The capability ID returned by evo_search.

tier.description: Disclosure level: L1 for compact contract/schema, L2 for full SOP/code/memory topology (default: L2).

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to the active project workspace. Routes EvoKernel to the nearest .evo/ directory at or above this path instead of the MCP server process cwd.
